findings.current: Cang Gong no longer looked toward the throne where the Emperor sat, nor did he bow toward it.
findings.defect: The draft places the Emperor sitting when the source says he is standing.
findings.rationale: 서 있는 explicitly describes the Emperor as standing.
findings.replacement: Cang Gong no longer looked toward the throne where the Emperor stood, nor did he bow toward it.
findings.source: 창공은 더 이상 황제가 서 있는 옥좌를 바라보지도, 그곳을 향해 허리를 굽히지도 않았다.

findings.current:
“Definitely delicious.”

“What was that?”

“Definitely delicious.”

“Right. But you should probably finish what’s in your mouth first.”
findings.defect: The draft invents a request for repetition and a second answer, while losing the muffled, mouth-full delivery of the only answer.
findings.rationale: The source has one garbled answer followed directly by Cang Gong’s response; the narrator repeats himself only after swallowing.
findings.replacement:
“Definithely delishious.”

“I see. But you should probably finish what’s in your mouth first.”
findings.source:
“확시히 마힛헤오.”

“그렇군. 하지만 우선 입에 든 것부터 처리하는 게 좋겠어.”

findings.current: “Long live His Highness! Long live! Long, long live!”
findings.defect: The acclamation becomes a generic cheer and adds an address absent from the chant, losing its thousand-year wording.
findings.rationale: The repeated 천세 and concluding 천천세 specify thousand-year acclamations for the heir.
findings.replacement: “A thousand years! A thousand years! A thousand thousand years!”

findings.current: An unspoken, chilling energy sealed off the area so completely that I wouldn’t have noticed it if I hadn’t been paying attention.
findings.defect: “Unspoken” misreads the energy’s subtlety, and the sentence makes its perceptibility depend specifically on the narrator.
findings.rationale: 은밀하고 describes the energy as discreet or subtle; 집중하지 않는다면 states the condition for sensing it without specifying a particular observer.
findings.replacement: A subtle, chilling qi sealed off the area so tightly that it would have gone unnoticed without careful attention.
findings.source: 집중하지 않는다면 느껴지지 않을 만큼 은밀하고 서늘한 기운이 주위를 단단히 틀어막았다.

summary: The draft adds a dialogue exchange, changes the Emperor’s position, and loses a distinction in the succession acclamation.
